rationale: Large source skills such as Impeccable and gstack are evidence sources and possible recipes; V2 production skills must be atomic, independently testable responsibilities.

Accessibility, safety, and performance may be global hard gates. Typography, eyebrow, card, theme, color, and other aesthetic rules remain context-selected variants unless the brief makes them constraints.
Product discovery and strategy skills produce evidence-backed recommendations and preserve unknowns; GO/PIVOT/KILL and build approval remain human decisions.

Customer interviews, tickets, proprietary data, recordings, and external LLM judge use require authorization, minimization, redaction, retention, transfer, and deletion boundaries; missing governance yields needs-input or blocked.
RICE, ICE, Opportunity Score, and similar named methods retain explicit formula variants. Every use records the exact formula and assumptions rather than claiming one universal convention.

Original skills remain immutable. Missing references, contradictory contracts, and broken generated files are recorded and their affected capabilities deferred; V2 may safely rewrite evidenced parts and must test them before release.
Keep semantic-read, behavior-reviewed, and excluded as top-level file review states. Express generated, vendor, fixture, binary, duplicate, and other distinctions through subkind and reason.
